---
title: "Gating Utilities"
---

Gating and event filtering utilities ported from
[CytoPipeline](https://uclouvain-cbio.github.io/CytoPipeline/) and
CytoPipelineUtils (UCLouvain-CBIO).

## `sw_gate_singlets` {#sw_gate_singlets}

Create a singlets gate.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_singlets(
  ff,
  filter_id = "Singlets",
  channel1 = "FSC-A",
  channel2 = "FSC-H",
  nmad,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `filter_id` | Gate name (default: `"Singlets"`). |
| `channel1` | Area channel (default: `"FSC-A"`). |
| `channel2` | Height channel (default: `"FSC-H"`). |
| `nmad` | Required, no default. Number of MADs around the median ratio. |
| `verbose` | Logical; print progress messages. |

### Details

Creates a parallelogram-shaped polygon gate for doublet removal based on the
ratio between two channels (typically FSC-A and FSC-H). Cells are retained if
their channel ratio is within `nmad` median absolute deviations of the median
ratio.

### Value

A `flowCore::polygonGate` object.

---

## `sw_filter_doublets` {#sw_filter_doublets}

Remove doublets using CytoPipeline algorithm.

### Usage

```r
sw_filter_doublets(
  ff,
  area_channels = c("FSC-A", "SSC-A"),
  height_channels = c("FSC-H", "SSC-H"),
  nmads,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `area_channels` | Character vector of area channels (default: `c("FSC-A", "SSC-A")`). |
| `height_channels` | Character vector of corresponding height channels (default: `c("FSC-H", "SSC-H")`). |
| `nmads` | Numeric vector of MAD multipliers, one per channel pair (required, no default). |
| `verbose` | Logical; print progress messages. |

### Details

Removes doublet events using the parallelogram singlet gate from
`sw_gate_singlets()`. Can apply gates on multiple channel pairs and combine
them.

### Value

A `flowFrame` with doublets removed.

---

## `sw_filter_doublets_peacoqc` {#sw_filter_doublets_peacoqc}

Remove doublets using PeacoQC.

### Usage

```r
sw_filter_doublets_peacoqc(
  ff,
  area_channels = c("FSC-A", "SSC-A"),
  height_channels = c("FSC-H", "SSC-H"),
  nmads,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `area_channels` | Character vector of area channels. |
| `height_channels` | Character vector of height channels. |
| `nmads` | Required, no default. Numeric vector of MAD multipliers, one per channel pair. |
| `verbose` | Logical; print progress messages (default: `TRUE`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `PeacoQC::RemoveDoublets()`. |

### Details

Removes doublet events using `PeacoQC::RemoveDoublets()`. Can apply on
multiple channel pairs sequentially.

### Value

A `flowFrame` with doublets removed.

---

## `sw_filter_debris` {#sw_filter_debris}

Remove debris using a manual polygon gate.

### Usage

```r
sw_filter_debris(ff, fsc_channel = "FSC-A", ssc_channel = "SSC-A",
                      gate_data, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `fsc_channel` | FSC channel name (default: `"FSC-A"`). |
| `ssc_channel` | SSC channel name (default: `"SSC-A"`). |
| `gate_data` | Numeric vector of polygon coordinates: first all x-coordinates (FSC), then all y-coordinates (SSC). |
| `verbose` | Logical; print events removed (default: `FALSE`). |

### Details

Removes debris events using a manual polygon gate in the FSC-A vs SSC-A 2D
space. Coordinates define the polygon boundary — events inside are retained.

### Value

A `flowFrame` with debris events removed. Attributes `events_in` and
`events_removed` hold the counts.

---

## `sw_filter_margins_peacoqc` {#sw_filter_margins_peacoqc}

Remove margin events using PeacoQC.

### Usage

```r
sw_filter_margins_peacoqc(x, channel_specifications = NULL, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A `flowFrame` or `flowSet`. |
| `channel_specifications` | Optional named list of per-channel range specifications. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `PeacoQC::RemoveMargins()`. |

### Details

Enhanced wrapper around `PeacoQC::RemoveMargins()` that automatically selects
signal channels and supports per-channel range specifications. Works on both
`flowFrame` and `flowSet` inputs.

### Value

A `flowFrame` or `flowSet` with margin events removed.
